rationale: PINS the M49 #741 fix (CONV-S-1): scala's detectFrameworks had no Spring entry, so a Spring Boot Scala file reported detectedFrameworks=[] while java ("spring"), kotlin ("Spring Boot"/"Spring Framework") and groovy ("spring") all detected it — the only JVM language blind to the dominant enterprise ecosystem. Detection is root-prefix only, so the fixture also pins the NEGATIVE direction via forbidFrameworks: `com.mycompany.springframework.internal.Thing`, `mycats.Custom` and `org.springlike.other.Widget` are user code containing framework roots as substrings and must produce nothing. Framework truth is differential-invisible (the oracle derives none), so fixtures are the only gate — the go framework-detection fixture records the same reasoning. Names follow kotlin's for the same ecosystem and scala's own Title-Case list style; java/groovy use the lowercase key "spring", a family divergence recorded in the spec as D21 rather than silently resolved here.
